final: WITH j AS (SELECT s.phasefactor AS ph, SUM(e.imgcount) AS tot FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.phasefactor), o AS (SELECT SUM(tot) AS overall FROM j), sh AS (SELECT j.ph, j.tot, j.tot * 1.0 / o.overall AS share FROM j JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM sh), k AS (SELECT sh.ph, sh.tot, sh.share, av.a FROM sh JOIN av ON av.a IS NOT NULL WHERE sh.share > av.a) SELECT SUM(tot) AS total_phase_totals, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - a) AS avg_share_diff FROM k
